battle.name: 黃巢攻長安之戰
battle.brief: 廣明元年十二月（881年1月），黃巢大軍自洛陽西破潼關，進據長安，唐僖宗出奔成都，義軍建齊稱帝。兩年後沙陀李克用與河中王重榮聯軍收復京師，黃巢敗死狼虎谷。卡面的羅馬方陣盾並未入華，它代表的是列陣咬合的盾線技術；唐廷此處靠的是城牆、弓弩與攻城器。

kit.name: 羅馬方陣盾
kit.history: 凸面的長方盾。羅馬的防線靠盾緣咬住盾緣，不是靠盾牌多厚。

countries: 交戰的一方是尚無國號的流寇式聯軍，另一方是名存實亡的唐廷與其麾下臨時拼湊起來的藩鎮聯軍。義軍方面：自乾符六年（879）起，王仙芝餘部與黃巢本部在河南、山南合流，形成以「隊」「夥」為基層的編制，步兵佔絕對多數，騎兵比例不高，攻城器械多靠徵用官軍器仗與繳獲，糧食就地取給於所經州縣；攻入京師之後，才於廣明元年十二月（881年1月）在長安建國號「齊」、改元金統，由黃巢自稱金天皇帝，其下分設內軍與外軍，內軍將領尚讓是巢最倚重的統帥。唐廷方面：僖宗出奔成都後中樞無主，靠各道節度使自募兵、自籌糧的自保體制運作，京師宿衛只剩神策軍一部與各府縣臨時糾集的鄉兵；能打的隊伍主要來自三處——河中節度使王重榮的精兵，昭義節度使孟方立、義武節度使王處直等北方藩鎮的兵，以及以沙陀騎兵為主、由河東節度使李克用率領的部落聯軍；這支部隊名義上受朝廷詔令，實際上只聽李克用一人。此外還有趁平巢之機坐大的淮西蔡州軍：忠孝軍節度使蔡中孚在883年後略地千里，其部眾劫掠無虛日，後由其子秦宗權接掌，成為唐末另一支獨立於朝廷之外的武裝。
countriesEn: One side was a band of insurgents with no state name at all; the other was a Tang court that existed in name only, together with a coalition of circuit governors hastily assembled around it. On the insurgent side: from 879, the survivors of Wang Xianzhi and Huang Chao's own following had joined up in Henan and in the mountains of the south, forming a structure whose base unit was the dui or the huo, with foot soldiers in overwhelming majority and cavalry a small fraction, siege equipment taken from government arsenals and from what was captured, and food obtained on the spot from the prefectures they marched through. Only after entering the capital did they found a state: in the twelfth month of the first year of Guangming, in January 881, they set up the name Qi at Chang'an, changed the era to Jintong, and Huang Chao took for himself the title of Golden Heaven Emperor, dividing his host into an inner and an outer army, with the inner-army commander Shang Rang as the commander he leaned on hardest. On the court side: once the emperor had fled to Chengdu there was no working centre of government, and the machine that ran was the circuit system, in which each governor raised his own soldiers and fed them from his own revenue. The garrison of the capital was reduced to a part of the Shence Army and to village levies hastily collected from the prefectures and counties. The fighting force came from three places: the picked troops of Wang Chongrong, governor of Hezhong; the contingents of northern circuits such as Meng Fangli of Zhaoyi and Wang Chuzhi of Yiwu; and a tribal coalition led by Li Keyong, governor of Hedong, whose core was the Shatuo cavalry. That last force answered to the court's summons in name, but in practice answered to Li Keyong alone. There was also the army of Cai prefecture in Huai-xi, which grew strong while the war against the insurgents was being fought: Cai Zhongfu, governor of the Zhongxiao Army, carried his operations over a thousand li after 883 and his troops lived off plunder, and his son Qin Zongquan later took over, becoming another armed force in the late Tang entirely outside the court's control.
people: 留下姓名的多在唐廷一方，義軍那邊則以黃巢與尚讓為核心。黃巢生年不詳、卒於884年，曹州冤句人，出身鹽幫，早年販私鹽，屢試進士不第；乾符六年前後他以王仙芝餘部為骨幹聚眾，朝廷曾企圖以節度使告身把他調離河南、發往江南赴鎮，他不受詔而殺死宣敕使者，寇兵於是變成明兵，此後朝廷招撫與各道追討都失卻信用。881年他自洛陽、潼關入長安稱帝，883年兵敗北走，部眾星散於泰山狼虎谷，為部下所殺（一說為追兵所殺，諸說並存）。尚讓是巢的內軍將，自雲州、宣州一路與巢同行；883年唐軍與沙陀聯軍會師渭橋時，義軍前鋒即由他統率，敗於梁田陂。唐方關鍵人物：河中節度使王重榮起初與義軍通款，後據河中而拒絕招撫，成為會剿的樞紐；他與李克用同樣在建軍立功，卻彼此忌憚，892年的河中與河東之戰即由此而起。沙陀節度使李克用（朱邪赤心之子，時人稱「李鴉兒」）在880年曾率沙陀軍入援京師而縱兵大掠，逼得僖宗出幸成都；883年又率沙陀精騎為聯軍先鋒，攻克長安後縱兵搜掠，遂開唐末「借外兵以平內亂」的弊病。僖宗李儇自成都還京後改為倚重沙陀與河中，朝政從此受制於藩鎮。此外還有奉詔會討的昭義節度使孟方立、義武節度使王處直，以及自蜀道迎駕還京的節度使朱玫；各節度使各領本鎮之兵，名為勤王，實則各懷自保之心。
peopleEn: The names that survive sit mostly on the Tang side; on the insurgent side the core was Huang Chao and Shang Rang. Huang Chao, whose year of birth is unknown and who died in 884, was a native of Yuanjue in Caozhou, the son of a salt-band family, and sold salt outside the monopoly while he was young; he failed the metropolitan examination repeatedly. Around 879 he gathered a following on the bones of Wang Xianzhi's survivors, and when the court tried to move him out of Henan with a certificate of appointment as circuit governor, sending him south to take up a post, he refused the edict and killed the bearer, and the band of bandits became an openly declared army. From that moment the court's overtures and the circuits' expeditions lost all credibility. He entered Chang'an by way of Luoyang and Tong Pass in 881 and proclaimed himself emperor; in 883 his army was beaten and scattered northwards, ending in the Langhu Valley on Mount Tai, where he was killed by his own men, though one account has pursuing troops taking his life, and the several versions stand side by side. Shang Rang was Chao's inner-army commander and had marched with him from Yunzhou and Xuanzhou; when the Tang and Shatuo coalition met at Weiqiao in 883 the insurgents' advance guard was his, and it was broken at Liangtianbei. On the Tang side the key figure was Wang Chongrong, governor of Hezhong, who at first corresponded with the insurgents but later held Hezhong and refused their overtures, becoming the hinge of the coalition; like Li Keyong he built his own power from the war, and the two were wary of each other, which is the seed of the war between Hezhong and Hedong in 892. Li Keyong, governor of Hedong, son of Zhuye Chixin, called Li Ya'er by his contemporaries, had led Shatuo troops into the capital to relieve it in 880 and let them sack the city, which drove the emperor out to Chengdu; in 883 he led the Shatuo cavalry as the vanguard of the coalition, and after the city fell his men were given over to plunder, opening the late Tang's practice of using outside troops to put down disorder within. Emperor Xizong returned from Chengdu to rely on the Shatuo and on Hezhong, and the government was from then on held in the grip of the circuit governors. Among the others who answered the summons were Meng Fangli of Zhaoyi, Wang Chuzhi of Yiwu, and the circuit governor Zhu Mei, who came up the road from Shu to meet the emperor's carriage. Each governor brought the soldiers of his own circuit, nominally to assist the throne, but each in fact looking after his own survival.
kits: 卡面上的羅馬方陣盾（Scutum，約公元前100年）不可能出現在881年的關中：它屬於羅馬共和末期至帝國早期的重裝步軍，一塊高約一米出頭、闊約半米多的凸面長方盾，木胎蒙皮包邊，中央留有盾突，羅馬人慣以長槍（hasta）與重投槍（pilum）配它使用；防線靠的是盾緣與盾緣相互咬合成連續的盾牆，而不是盾本身有多厚，進攻時再疊成龜甲陣，護住投石手與填壕者。羅馬帝國解體之後，這種形制在歐洲退出實用，直到十五世紀義大利的長矛兵重新用上同類的大長方盾，而那已是另一個世界的事。881年的關中，義軍與官軍手上是另一套東西：官軍步卒以皮甲、札甲為主，長柄矛與陌刀為骨幹，遠射用弓與弩，攻城靠雲梯、撞木、火箭與穴地，防守倚城牆、坊牆與拒馬；義軍多無甲或僅以粗布纏身，攻城主要依賴徵用與繳獲的器械，靠人海貼牆、夜間架梯突門。與方陣盾功能最接近的，是守城時舉在面前的木盾與大楯，以及用來抵拒衝撞的拒馬；與龜甲陣思路最接近的，是穴地進攻時以木板與土袋遮蔽填壕者的做法，但唐人並未把盾線當成建制的核心，盾牌是裝備而非編制的骨架。武器技術從來不是單線傳播：羅馬用盾線配合投槍與近戰，唐廷用城牆配合弩箭與攻城器，各自在自己的地理與制度裡找到答案。
kitsEn: The Roman scutum on the card could not have been present in the passes of Guanzhong in 881. It belonged to the heavy infantry of the late Republic and the early Empire: a convex rectangle of wood covered in hide with a bound rim, a little over a metre tall and rather more than half a metre wide, with a boss left in the middle, and the Roman habit was to carry it with the long spear, the hasta, and the heavy throwing spear, the pilum. The line was made not by the thickness of any one shield but by the rim of one shield biting the rim of the next so that a continuous wall of shields was formed, and on the attack the same shields were stacked into a testudo to cover the slingers and the men filling the ditch. When the Roman state came apart this shape fell out of practical use in Europe, and it was the Italian pikemen of the fifteenth century who took up a large rectangular shield of the same family again, by which time it belonged to a different world altogether. What the insurgents and the government troops held in Guanzhong in 881 was a different set of things. Government infantry were protected by leather and lamellar armour, with the long spear and the modao as the backbone of the close fighting, the bow and the crossbow for missile work, and for the attack on walls the scaling ladder, the ram, fire arrows and the mine; for the defence they relied on the wall, the ward barriers and abatis. The insurgents for the most part had no armour at all, or only coarse cloth wound about the body, and depended on equipment taken from government stores and on what they captured, pressing masses of men against the wall and putting up ladders at night to burst the gates. The closest functional relatives of the scutum were the wooden shields and large mantlets raised in front of the men on the wall, and the abatis set up to resist the impact of a ram. The closest counterpart to the thinking behind the testudo was the practice of screening the men who filled a ditch with planks and sacks of earth, but the Tang never made the shield line the core of an organisation: for them the shield was equipment, not the skeleton of the establishment. Weapon technology has never travelled along a single line. Rome used a wall of shields with the throwing spear and hand-to-hand fighting; the Tang court used walls with crossbow bolts and siege engines, and each found its own answer in its own geography and institutions.
tactics: 這場戰役的戰術可以分兩段看。前段是義軍如何打下長安：自河南西進，過洛陽而不在城中停留，兵不血刃地西破潼關——關中的門戶一開，長安便再無可守；入城之後不設防、不編戶、不修宮室，只縱兵搜括府庫器仗與財貨，這顯出流寇式軍隊「取城而走」的本性，也是其後兩年不能固守京師的根源。後段是唐廷聯軍如何收復：河中、昭義、義武諸軍與沙陀騎兵在渭橋一線會師，以沙陀為鋒，尋常步陣尚未接觸，遊騎先以強弩與標槍擾亂義軍營列，再由步兵結陣推進，在梁田陂一戰破義軍前鋒，隨即直逼城下光泰門與乾門一帶；義軍守軍焚宮室夜走，聯軍入城，李克用所部縱兵大掠數日而後西撤。追擊階段是沙陀騎兵的長項：連騎追奔直至山東泰山一帶，義軍沿途失去水源與糧秣，部眾星散，終至狼虎谷一帶全軍覆沒。整體看，義軍的戰術核心是流動、掃掠、趁虛而動；唐廷聯軍的核心是集兵、倚城、以精騎決勝負。兩者都不擅長守城，也都沒有把攻城器械的破城之力用來鞏固陣地——這正是883年收復長安之後再無人能守的緣由。
tacticsEn: The tactics of this campaign can be read in two parts. The first is how the insurgents took Chang'an. Moving west from Henan, they passed Luoyang without staying in it and opened Tong Pass without a serious fight, and once the gate of Guanzhong was open there was nothing left to defend Chang'an against. After entering the city they set up no defences, drew up no registers and repaired no palace; they simply let the troops sweep up the stores, the equipment and the treasure of the treasuries. That showed the character of a bandit army that takes a city and moves on, and it was the root of the inability to hold the capital in the two years that followed. The second part is how the Tang coalition recovered it. The troops of Hezhong, Zhaoyi and Yiwu and the Shatuo cavalry met in a line along the Weiqiao, with the Shatuo in front: before the regular infantry had even come to close quarters, the outriders harried the insurgent camp with heavy crossbows and javelins, and then the foot closed up and advanced in order, breaking the insurgent vanguard in the action at Liangtianbei and pressing straight down to the Guangtai Gate and the Qianmen below the city. The insurgents burned the palace and left by night, the coalition entered, and Li Keyong's men were given over to plunder for several days before withdrawing westward. The pursuit was what the Shatuo cavalry was good at: riding hard in a long column as far as the Mount Tai region of Shandong, the insurgents losing water and grain on the way, their numbers scattering, until the whole force came to nothing in the Langhu Valley. Taken as a whole, the tactical core of the insurgents was movement, sweeping and seizing the moment; that of the Tang coalition was massing the troops, leaning on the city and letting good horse decide the day. Neither was good at holding a city, and neither used the destructive power of its siege engines to make a permanent position, which is exactly why nobody was able to hold Chang'an after 883.
data: 可核對的數字分幾類，諸史多有誇飾，須打折看。年月最為確定：黃巢於乾符六年（879）冬不受朝廷封爵而反，880年冬進軍河南，廣明元年（880）末至十二月（881年1月）之間連下洛陽、破潼關、入長安；883年二月至三月間唐軍與沙陀聯軍會師渭橋、破義軍前鋒，883年春夏黃巢敗走泰山狼虎谷，僖宗同年十二月還京。距離與行程：洛陽至長安直線約四百公里，沿崤函古道行軍約五百至六百公里，義軍自洛陽陷落到進抵長安不足一月；聯軍追擊由關中直抵泰山，路程逾千里。城池尺度：長安承隋大興城之基，周長約二十五公里，面積八十餘平方公里，城牆高約十米上下（諸說有八九米至十二米不等），是當時世上最大的城之一；潼關扼關中東戶，形勢險要而守備空虛，開關不過數日。兵力：義軍入京時人數諸史或稱百萬，即使減半亦不弱；聯軍自稱十五萬，李克用所率沙陀騎兵或稱五千、或稱萬餘，說法不一；883年渭橋之戰，通行本紀數為斬首萬餘級。損失與物資：長安府庫為義軍所掠一空，唐廷兩年無京師，兩京官私器仗與財貨大量流失；黃巢死後降眾或稱十餘萬，朝廷以補各道兵籍，成為唐末軍制的隱患。
dataEn: The verifiable figures fall into several classes, and the histories embellish most of them, so they have to be discounted. The dates are the firmest: Huang Chao rejected the court's appointment in the winter of 879 and rose; in the winter of 880 he marched into Henan; and between the end of the first year of Guangming and its twelfth month, that is between late 880 and January 881, he took Luoyang, opened Tong Pass and entered Chang'an. Between the second and third months of 883 the Tang and Shatuo coalition met at Weiqiao and broke the insurgent vanguard; in the spring and summer of 883 Huang Chao was driven north to the Langhu Valley on Mount Tai; and in the twelfth month of the same year the emperor returned to the capital. Distances and marching: the straight line from Luoyang to Chang'an is about four hundred kilometres, and the march by the old Xiaohan road about five or six hundred; the insurgents took less than a month from the fall of Luoyang to the walls of Chang'an. The pursuit from Guanzhong to Mount Tai runs to more than a thousand kilometres. The size of the city: Chang'an was built on the plan of the Sui capital Daxing, with a circuit of about twenty-five kilometres, an area of more than eighty square kilometres, and walls some ten metres high, though the accounts give anything from eight or nine metres to twelve; it was one of the largest cities in the world at the time. Tong Pass commands the eastern entrance to Guanzhong, a position of great strength that was thinly held, and the gate was open for no more than a few days. Strength: the number the insurgents entered the capital with is given by the histories as a million, and even halved it was no small force; the coalition called itself a hundred and fifty thousand; the Shatuo cavalry under Li Keyong is given as five thousand in one place and as more than ten thousand in another. The action at Weiqiao in 883 is credited in the standard annals with more than ten thousand enemy dead. Losses and stores: the treasuries of Chang'an were emptied by the insurgents, the court was two years without a capital, and the arms and wealth of the two cities were massively drained. After Huang Chao's death his surrendered men are put at more than a hundred thousand; the court distributed them among the circuits' rosters, and that became a standing danger in the late Tang military system.
cause: 打起來有四層原因。最外層是朝廷自己製造的：乾符六年（879）朝廷既已平定王仙芝之亂，本可解散餘眾，卻企圖以一紙節度使告身把黃巢調離河南、發往江南赴鎮；黃巢不受詔，殺死宣敕使者，寇兵於是變成明兵，此後朝廷的招撫與各道的追討都失去信用，雙方再無轉圜餘地。第二層是治理失效：唐末節度使掌兵掌財，朝廷號令不出四方，州縣兵少、承平既久不習戰、遇盜多敗；連歲旱蝗、饑饉逼迫，耕桑半廢，租賦不足，內藏虛竭，朝廷甚至要靠出賣空白告身來籌軍費。義軍因此既有兵源，也有就地取糧的辦法。第三層是空間的：洛陽與長安之間的崤函古道與潼關是關中的門戶，潼關守軍在朝廷威信喪盡之後倒戈或鬆懈，一夜之間關門洞開，兩京之間再無屏障。第四層是更深的心態與體制：僖宗在880年因沙陀軍入援京師而縱兵大掠一事倉皇出幸成都，京師人心已散；朝廷兩度播遷，禁軍與朝官離心，節度使各懷自保之心，於是同一場叛亂在兩年之間既是「流寇攻城」，也是「藩鎮勤王」——這正是這場戰役與此前任何一次州縣之亂都不同的地方。
causeEn: There are four layers of cause. The outermost was manufactured by the court itself. In 879, having just suppressed the revolt of Wang Xianzhi, the government could have disbanded his followers, and instead it tried to move Huang Chao out of Henan with a certificate appointing him circuit governor and sending him south to take up his post. Chao refused the edict and killed its bearer; bandits became an openly declared army, and from that day neither the court's overtures nor the circuits' expeditions had any credibility left, and there was no way back for either side. The second layer is the failure of government. In the late Tang the circuit governors held the troops and the revenue, the court's orders no longer reached the four quarters, the counties had few soldiers, long years of peace had left them unpractised, and they usually lost when they met bandits; with drought, locusts, famine and the flight of the people, half the farmland lay abandoned, rents were short and the treasury empty, and the court had to sell blank certificates of office to raise military funds. The insurgents therefore had both a supply of recruits and a way of feeding themselves where they stood. The third layer is geographical. The old Xiaohan road and Tong Pass between Luoyang and Chang'an are the doorway of Guanzhong; once the Tang Pass garrison, its morale broken with the authority of the court, went over or let go, the gate stood open in a single night and there was no barrier left between the two capitals. The fourth layer lies deeper, in temperament and in the structure of power. In 880, after the Shatuo troops came to relieve the capital and sacked it, the emperor fled in haste to Chengdu and the heart of the capital had already gone out of the people; the court moved twice, the guards and the ministers were alienated, and every circuit governor thought first of his own survival. The same rebellion thus became, within two years, both an assault by bandits on the capital and a rising of the provincial armies to aid the throne, and that is what distinguishes this campaign from every county-level revolt that came before it.
impact: 這場戰役是唐末亂局的分水嶺。第一，兩京陷落近兩年，府庫為空，唐廷的財政與信用同時受損；僖宗還京後改以「借外兵平叛」為常例，先倚沙陀，後倚河中，日後朱溫代唐的路線其實早在883年就已被寫下。第二，藩鎮坐大：河中王重榮、昭義孟方立、義武王處直各擁私兵，而受詔會討的沙陀與淮西蔡州軍趁勢擴張；蔡中孚的忠孝軍在平巢之後略地千里，887年秦宗權殺之而據蔡州，888年稱帝，橫掃關東，唐廷自此再無恢復元氣的可能。第三，黃巢降眾被分授各道兵籍，十餘萬流寇一次性轉化為藩鎮精兵，這批人此後在淮西、忠武、河東各軍中成為骨幹，也把「兵不屬將、將不專兵」的弊病帶進五代十國。第四，武器史上的對照最為清楚：羅馬的聯鎖盾線、龜甲陣與重投槍，自西元前一世紀之後便與中國無緣，唐廷的答案是城牆、弩箭、火箭與穴地攻城；881年的關中城牆再高，也擋不住一座從內部崩解、又從外部被叛將開關的首都。
impactEn: This campaign was the watershed of the disorder in the late Tang. First, the two capitals were lost for nearly two years and the treasuries were emptied, so that the court's finances and its credit were damaged together; once Xizong was back in the capital he made it regular practice to hire outside troops to put down disorder, leaning first on the Shatuo and then on Hezhong, and the road that ended in Zhu Wen replacing the Tang in 903 had really been written down in 883. Second, the circuit governors grew strong: Wang Chongrong of Hezhong, Meng Fangli of Zhaoyi and Wang Chuzhi of Yiwu each kept private troops, while the Shatuo and the army of Cai prefecture in Huai-xi, summoned to help, expanded at the court's expense. After the war against the insurgents, the Zhongxiao Army under Cai Zhongfu carried its operations over a thousand li; in 887 Qin Zongquan killed him and seized Cai prefecture, and in 888 proclaimed himself emperor and swept the eastern circuits, after which the court had no hope of recovering its strength. Third, the insurgents who surrendered after Huang Chao's death were distributed into the circuits' rosters: some hundred thousand men who had been bandits were turned in a single stroke into the picked troops of the military governors, and they became the backbone of the armies of Huai-xi, Zhongwu and Hedong, carrying the vice of soldiers who belonged to no commander and commanders who owned no soldiers into the Five Dynasties and the Ten Kingdoms. Fourth, the contrast in the history of weapons is the plainest of all: the interlocking shield line, the testudo and the heavy throwing spear of Rome had no contact with China after the first century before the present, and the Tang court's answer was the wall, the crossbow bolt, the fire arrow and the mine. The walls of Guanzhong in 881 were high enough, and they still could not hold a capital that was coming apart from within and was unlocked from outside by a mutinous garrison.
result: 廣明元年十二月（881年1月），黃巢自洛陽西破潼關，進據長安，僖宗出奔成都，義軍建國號齊、改元金統：唐廷失去京師近兩年，這是它自安史之亂以來最重的一次打擊。883年，僖宗在成都、興元一線下詔各道會討，河中王重榮、昭義孟方立、義武王處直與河東沙陀李克用聯軍自北面南下，以李克用部為先鋒，二月會師渭橋，破義軍前鋒尚讓於梁田陂，遂進逼長安；義軍焚宮室夜走，聯軍入城，李克用所部大掠而後西撤，僖宗同年十二月還京。黃巢北走，終於泰山狼虎谷，部眾星散，兵敗被殺。就軍事結果而言，是義軍攻下了長安卻守不住它，最終敗於同一批藩鎮聯軍之手；就政治結果而言，是唐廷靠外藩與外族之兵收復京師，收回一座空城，卻把實權拱手讓給藩鎮，黃巢之亂由此由一場攻城戰變成一場改變帝國權力結構的戰爭。黃巢本人則了結在狼虎谷，成為中國史上最後一位真正以流民入主京師的亂首；此後的天下大亂，性質已由「流寇攻城」轉為「藩鎮割據」，唐朝的崩解自此只待時日。
resultEn: In the twelfth month of the first year of Guangming, in January 881, Huang Chao opened Tong Pass from the west of Luoyang, took up position in Chang'an and the emperor fled to Chengdu; the insurgents founded the state of Qi and changed the era to Jintong. The Tang court was without its capital for nearly two years, the heaviest blow it had suffered since the rebellion of An Lushan. In 883 the emperor, at Chengdu and in the line of Xingyuan, issued summons for the circuits to join in the campaign; the coalition of Wang Chongrong of Hezhong, Meng Fangli of Zhaoyi, Wang Chuzhi of Yiwu and Li Keyong of Hedong with his Shatuo came down from the north with Li Keyong's men as vanguard, met at Weiqiao in the second month, broke the insurgent vanguard under Shang Rang at Liangtianbei and pressed up to Chang'an. The insurgents burned the palace and left by night; the coalition entered the city, Li Keyong's men plundered it and then withdrew westward; and in the twelfth month of the same year the emperor returned to the capital. Huang Chao went north and came to his end in the Langhu Valley on Mount Tai, his numbers scattering and his army destroyed. In military terms the result is clear enough: the insurgents took Chang'an and could not keep it, and were finally beaten by the same coalition of circuit governors; in political terms the Tang court recovered its capital with the troops of outlying provinces and of a foreign people, recovered an empty city, and handed the real power over to the circuit governors. The rebellion of Huang Chao had thus turned from an assault on a city into a war that altered the structure of imperial power. Huang Chao himself ended in the Langhu Valley and was the last in Chinese history to enter the capital at the head of a refugee horde; the great disorder that followed changed its character, from an assault by bandits on the capital to a partition of the empire among the circuit governors, and the fall of the Tang after that was only a matter of time.
